prompt: Replay the full onboarding so I can try setup again. Keep my current data.

variants.base: Native completed-profile replay followed by all six shared product steps.
variants.holdout: Development web settings replay; leave midway, reload the app, replay from settings again, complete all steps; production web must hide replay.

checks.REPLAYUI: Native replay reaches the native setup and product welcome, then welcome, brain, about, email, telegram and open complete through real rendered controls.
checks.DATA: Original connection, chat, credential reference, account completion and preferences remain equal before and after; no reconnect, disconnect, model sign-in or conversation-reset request occurs.
checks.DEV: Actual development build exposes replay in settings and restarts at welcome; actual production build does not expose it and redirects completed accounts away from /onboarding.

evidence_scope: Native runtime is a prerequisite. Renderer fixtures and main-process contract tests supplement, but cannot replace, a missing native end-to-end result. No live model or connected-account calls.
answer_key: The checks above and before-state snapshots remain evaluator-owned; the app receives only ordinary API state and UI input.
